basic_details.scholarship_name: King Saud University (KSU) International Student Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Saudi Ministry of Education & King Saud University (Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: King Saud University (Main Campus, Diriyah, Riyadh)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to leading faculties: College of Computer and Information Sciences (Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Information Technology, AI), College of Engineering, College of Science, and College of Pharmacy / Science tracks.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 1,200 to 1,800 international external scholarships awarded annually across all KSU colleges under the Saudi Government Scholarship Program
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Saudi Ministry of Education bilateral country quota: typically 60 to 90 Pakistani scholars selected annually across undergraduate and postgraduate levels
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor (plus 1 prep/language year); 2 years for Master; 3 to 4 years for PhD, subject to maintaining high academic standing

nationality_requirements: Non-Saudi citizens residing outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (External Scholarship Program)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years of age; Master's applicants must be 30 or younger; PhD applicants must be 35 or younger.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: For Bachelor: Completed Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / Intermediate / A-Levels) with minimum 78% marks (Grade 'Very Good' or 'Excellent'). For Master/PhD: Completed 16-year Bachelor's or 18-year Master's with minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00 (or 4.00 / 5.00) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum high 'Very Good' (Jayyid Jiddan Murtania) or 'Excellent' (Mumtaz) rating on certificates, equivalent to CGPA >= 3.40/4.00 or 78%+.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering, Computer Science, or Mathematical sciences background for College of Computer and Information Sciences and College of Engineering.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated within the past 5 years from date of application (undergraduate requirement).
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Secondary graduation certificate must not be older than 5 years at application.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; research publications and technical projects strongly enhance graduate applications.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Official IELTS minimum 6.0 or TOEFL iBT minimum 75 required for graduate programs and direct English-medium undergraduate STEM admissions. MOI certificates are generally not accepted for graduate admission.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: 1-year intensive Arabic language preparatory program provided for undergraduate programs taught in Arabic. Scientific, computing, and engineering disciplines are taught 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female candidates must have an eligible Mahram (male guardian) who is also an enrolled student, employed, or legal resident in Saudi Arabia, unless Saudi regulations permit independent university hostel residency for international female scholarship recipients.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: International applicants under the Saudi Ministry of Education bilateral country quota and KSU international academic excellence scheme.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicant must not have previously received an educational scholarship from another institution in Saudi Arabia.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full international tuition fee waiver across all academic semesters, preparatory programs, and thesis research.

admission_application_fee.details: Online application via KSU international admissions portal and Study in Saudi portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free fully furnished student housing in KSU Student Dormitory Complex in Riyadh, equipped with air conditioning, gym, high-speed Wi-Fi, and utilities.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend: SAR 1,900 / month for Undergraduate students; SAR 2,900 / month for Master's and PhD researchers (~PKR 215,000/mo).

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy air tickets between Pakistan and Riyadh for summer break, plus initial arrival flight ticket upon admission.

visa_fee.details: Saudi Student Visa and residence permit (Iqama) issued and renewed annually free of charge by the Saudi government.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive premium medical, dental, and surgical healthcare provided at King Khalid University Hospital and King Abdulaziz University Hospital in Riyadh.
health_insurance.amount: Full healthcare at KSU University Hospitals

food_allowance.details: Heavily subsidized gourmet campus dining halls and student cafeterias across KSU campus (~SAR 3 to 6 per meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Annual book allowance (equivalent to one month stipend), thesis printing grant of SAR 3,000 (Master) / SAR 4,000 (PhD), and free central library access.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Generous research grants, world-class laboratory access, supercomputing resources, and conference travel funding via KSU Deanship of Scientific Research.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free KSU on-campus transit bus network connecting residential complexes, academic faculties, sports arenas, and Riyadh Metro station.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university: King Saud University (Diriyah, Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier flagship national university of Saudi Arabia; ranked #1 in Saudi Arabia and Top 150-200 in the world (QS World University Rankings / Shanghai ARWU #101-150).
available_majors: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
Bachelor of Science in Information Systems
Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering
Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering
Master of Science in Computer Science
Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence
Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science
Doctor of Philosophy in Electrical Engineering
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Undergraduate: 4 to 5 years (including prep year); Master: 2 years (4 semesters); PhD: 3 to 4 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: HSSC/Intermediate with >= 78% marks or Bachelor/Master with CGPA >= 3.40/4.00, IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 75+, clean police certificate, GAMCA medical fitness, and attested educational documents.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Computer and Information Sciences and College of Engineering are the most competitive academic faculties in Saudi Arabia; early application with strong GPA and GRE/IELTS is essential.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply via the official KSU portal (siadmission.ksu.edu.sa) and the unified Study in Saudi portal. Ensure all transcripts are attested by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan before uploading.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: King Saud University International Admissions Portal (SIAdmission) & Study in Saudi Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the KSU International Student Admissions portal (siadmission.ksu.edu.sa), fill the electronic application form, select academic degree program, and upload all required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Attest academic certificates and transcripts from IBCC/HEC and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan; obtain certified Arabic translations.
Step 2: Obtain Police Character Clearance Certificate from Police Khidmat Markaz and get it attested by MOFA Pakistan.
Step 3: Take IELTS Academic (minimum 6.0) or TOEFL iBT (minimum 75) test and obtain official scorecard.
Step 4: Register on the KSU International Admissions portal (siadmission.ksu.edu.sa) during the November to January intake window.
Step 5: Fill in personal and academic information, select major (College of Computer and Information Sciences / Engineering), and upload high-resolution document scans.
Step 6: KSU Departmental Admissions Committees conduct academic and research reviews and rank applicants by competitive merit.
Step 7: Shortlisted applicants undergo security clearance by the Saudi Ministry of Education and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (April - June).
Step 8: Final scholarship award notification issued; Saudi MOE issues electronic visa slip.
Step 9: Complete medical screening at GAMCA-approved center in Pakistan, submit passport to Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi for Student Visa stamping.
Step 10: University issues complimentary round-trip flight ticket; arrive at King Khalid International Airport (Riyadh) for university reception and student housing check-in.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Government Routing: Admission to King Saud University for international applicants automatically confers full government scholarship award.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters from university professors uploaded directly in PDF format on the SIAdmission portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose outlining academic background, intellectual interests, career ambitions, and motivation for studying at King Saud University.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Master's and PhD applicants must submit a 3 to 5-page research proposal outlining the intended thesis focus, literature review, and proposed methodology.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic curriculum vitae listing educational history, publications, honors, research experience, and technical competencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Generally no interview conducted; selection is based on comprehensive document evaluation and academic credentials (departments may occasionally conduct online interviews for PhD candidates).
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.0) or TOEFL iBT (min 75); GRE General Test strongly recommended for graduate STEM applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan, followed by Saudi Cultural Mission and Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia upon final selection.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified Arabic translation for all English/Urdu educational documents and police clearance certificate.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via King Saud University SIAdmission portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of passport identification page with at least two years validity.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have at least 6 blank pages.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official degrees and detailed mark sheets with high academic standing.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC / HEC and MOFA Pakistan, with certified Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS (min 6.0) or TOEFL iBT (min 75) score report.
Official Police Character Certificate verifying clean record with no criminal history.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by Police Khidmat Markaz, attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive medical fitness certificate verifying freedom from contagious illnesses (HIV, Hepatitis B/C, TB).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Completed at an authorized GAMCA / GCC approved medical center in Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letters of recommendation from recognized university professors on institutional letterhead.
Detailed statement of purpose for Bachelor's or 3-5 page research proposal for Master's/PhD.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Well-formulated academic plan aligned with KSU research priorities.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed CV listing academic qualifications, projects, publications, and awards.
Official NADRA computerized birth certificate confirming date of birth and parentage.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: NADRA Birth Certificate attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

important_dates_timeline.interview_period: None (Document review; March - April for PhD candidates if required)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Annual international application cycle open from November to January for Fall semester intake.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 45% (Academic GPA/percentage, course rigor, and university prestige)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 20% (Research publications, conference papers, and proposal quality for postgrad)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry or teaching experience relevant to field)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of educational purpose, SOP, and motivation)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 5% (Academic referee appraisals of intellectual excellence and integrity)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Document-based review; oral interview evaluated qualitatively if conducted)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Pure merit competition under bilateral government quota)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: KSU College Admissions Committees, Deanship of Graduate Studies, Saudi Ministry of Education Scholarship Board, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: Academic and departmental ranking based on GPA, test scores, and research proposal, followed by Saudi MOE and MOFA security clearance.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~15,000 to 22,000 international applicants across all disciplines worldwide
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~1,200 to 1,800 international scholarships across KSU colleges
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~12.0% (Highly competitive due to national flagship status; Pakistani quota typically sees strong applicant pool)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 85%+ in Pakistani Intermediate (HSSC / Pre-Engineering / ICS) or 3.60+ CGPA for Master/PhD
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top-tier academic performers with strong IELTS scores (6.5+), research publications or preprints (for postgrad), and complete attested documents.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, COMSATS, UET Lahore, and top BISE board position holders.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Egypt, Indonesia, Jordan, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Malaysia, Turkey

fake_websites_and_scams: Fraudulent consultancies and agent portals claiming to sell King Saud University admission or visas. KSU scholarships are 100% free and strictly applied for via siadmission.ksu.edu.sa and studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa.
Fake emails asking for medical or registration deposits; KSU never charges admission or scholarship fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for King Saud University scholarships is 100% free of charge. Any fee demand is fraudulent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: King Saud University does not cooperate with any educational agency or recruiter; third-party applications risk immediate disqualification.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS / TOEFL examination fee in Pakistan (~PKR 60,000).
Medical examination at GAMCA-approved center in Pakistan (~PKR 18,000 - 25,000).
Document attestation fees at IBCC, HEC, MOFA, and certified Arabic translation (~PKR 25,000 - 45,000).
Initial cash needed upon arrival in Riyadh before the first stipend disbursement (~SAR 800 - 1,200; ~PKR 60,000 - 90,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: English is not used at KSU. Reality: College of Computer and Information Sciences and College of Engineering teach all lectures, assignments, and exams in English.
Myth: External scholarship students can work part-time in Riyadh. Reality: Scholarship visa regulations strictly prohibit outside commercial employment in Saudi Arabia.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs suggest scholarships can be transferred to King Abdulaziz University or KFUPM; regulations strictly prohibit transfer between universities.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of at least 3.00 / 5.00 (undergrad) or 3.75 / 5.00 (graduate); lower GPA triggers academic probation and stipend suspension.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time attendance; unexcused absence exceeding 25% results in denial from taking final examinations and scholarship review.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Termly academic transcripts reviewed by the Deanship of Admissions and Registration.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Holders of international student residency (Iqama) are legally prohibited from outside commercial employment in the Kingdom.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars must depart the Kingdom upon completion of studies within the timeframe stipulated by Saudi immigration authorities (typically 3 months).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or financial repayment requirement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled upon academic dismissal or violation of university disciplinary rules; disbursed funds are not clawed back.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another university within Saudi Arabia is strictly prohibited for external scholarship recipients.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing majors is permitted only within the same college during the first academic year subject to departmental council approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship duration cannot exceed the standard degree timeline plus one additional semester with explicit approval from the Ministry of Education.
